Guwahati Traffic Police has issued a detailed traffic advisory for the upcoming Durga Puja, effective from September 28 to October 3, 2025. The restrictions aim to ensure smooth vehicular movement, public safety, and hassle-free passage for emergency vehicles like ambulances and fire tenders during the festive days.

#durgapuja #guwahtitrafficpolice #TheAssamTribune
